dct_description_sm: The project has two goals: (1) To determine the effect of climate change and environmental gradients on the growth rate of the two dominant bryophytes (mosses) in Labrador; (2) To compare the growth rate of bryophytes to tree seedlings and determine if are they competing. For further analysis and results for this question, see studies by Julia Wheeler (for example, CCIN Ref. Nos. 1217 and 1405, 'Black spruce emergence and early seedling survival in the Mealy Mountains, Labrador' and 'Open-Top Chamber (OTC) data from the Torngat Mountains National Park').
dct_title_s: Growth rate and environmental stress of Bryophytes in the Torngat and Mealy Mountains, Labrador
